name: Chennai floods, December 2015
description: 48 hours of synthetic SOS traffic modelled on the December 2015 Chennai floods: 450 households in real localities along the Adyar, the southern marshes and the Buckingham Canal, reported by relatives in English, Tamil, Hindi, Malayalam and Telugu, with duplicates, vague and stale reports. No real person's data.
